The campaign supports a community repair workshop that teaches residents to maintain bicycles and household items. The initial fundraising goal is to equip two workbenches, purchase shared tools, and fund six months of weekend sessions. No final monetary target has been approved. The campaign should emphasize practical skills, reuse, neighbour-to-neighbour learning, and local ownership. Avoid pity-based imagery, staged cheque handovers, and claims about jobs created.
